structural_neighborhood_bin_policy.broad_bucket_ambiguous: structure exists but same/different mechanism interpretation is not reliable
structural_neighborhood_bin_policy.dense_same_mechanism_structural_neighbor: primary heldout row; nearest train structural neighbor has same fingerprint and high Foldseek proxy
structural_neighborhood_bin_policy.foldseek_high_structure_proxy: nearest Foldseek prob >= 0.5 or bits >= 50, used only to label diagnostic neighborhoods
structural_neighborhood_bin_policy.high_structure_similarity_different_fing: nearest train structural neighbor has a primary/different fingerprint under high Foldseek proxy, including OOS/secondary traps
structural_neighborhood_bin_policy.low_structure_neighborhood_near_orphan: prior orphan design row or primary row with weak Foldseek proxy and no same-fingerprint retained TM evidence
structural_neighborhood_bin_policy.no_reliable_structure: coordinate unavailable or Foldseek status not reported

oos_abstention_diagnostics.abstention_rule: predicted out_of_scope class only; no heldout-tuned confidence threshold

oos_abstention_diagnostics.threshold_selection_rule: no learned threshold selected; out_of_scope nearest-neighbor label is counted as abstention and primary-fingerprint prediction is counted as false positive

overlap_diagnostic_for_any_threshold_sep.threshold_selection_rule: no_similarity_threshold_selected; abstention occurs only when nearest train row label_group is out_of_scope

explicit_non_claims: Foldseek broad-bucket performance is not mechanism prediction proof.
Proposal v2 sublabels are not registry or production labels.
No thresholds, imports, label edits, ontology edits, or production scoring decisions are made by this artifact.
interpretation.next_month_decision: Do not scale models first. Build a Foldseek-plus-geometry diagnostic engine, freeze fold-controlled and near-orphan evals, report proposal-only v2 sublabel strata, and acquire targeted labels for sparse contrast cells.
interpretation.primary_conclusion: Wave 1 is best read as broad-bucket structural-neighborhood transfer plus abstention diagnostics, not as evidence that a larger learned model has solved mechanism prediction.
why: Foldseek and SaProt are strongest when heldout rows sit in dense same-fingerprint structural neighborhoods.
High-structure-similarity different-fingerprint and near-orphan rows remain the decision surface for mechanism claims.
Sequence-only learned reps are inconsistent across sparse fingerprints and still fail or abstain on many primary rows.
Geometry often succeeds on near-orphan rows in the prior design, so the practical engine should combine Foldseek, geometry, and abstention rather than chase model scale first.
